entry.title: ECB Seeks Partners for Appia Tokenized Finance Tests
entry.summary: Applications for the first exercises are due Dec. 11, with later submissions reviewed on a rolling basis. The call includes deposit-settlement tests using mock central bank money.

entry.title: Chainflip Halts Swaps Over Potential Vault Exploit
entry.summary: Deposits, withdrawals and quotes are disabled. A security monitor flagged Ethereum vault outflows it valued at about $4.86 million.

entry.title: Aave Voters Back Plan to Narrow V3 Core Collateral
entry.summary: Existing loans would stay open as LlamaRisk’s plan steers borrowers toward retained collateral or Aave V4.

entry.title: Bitcoin Hits $55,106 on Coinbase, Lowest Since September 2024
entry.summary: Coinbase's low left bitcoin 35.1% below its Oct. 21 intraday high. Kraken recorded $55,100 in the same minute.

entry.title: Masullo’s Riemann Claim Draws AI-Assisted Objections
entry.summary: Vakil reported AI-assisted objections to Masullo’s draft. A separate Claude-assisted proof has passed independent formal checks, according to an MIT mathematician.

entry.title: Bitcoin Core Fixes AI-Found Bug That Could Stall Nodes
entry.summary: Versions 30.5 and 31.3 patch a medium-severity flaw found through Spiral’s Loupe scanner. The retired 29.x branch will not get a fix.

entry.title: XRP Sets New November Low on Coinbase, Down 10% in 24 Hours
entry.summary: XRP fell to $0.8663 late Friday, below its Nov. 14 trough. Its daily loss matched the broader selloff, while its weekly decline was smaller than bitcoin's and ether's.

entry.title: Bitcoin Hits $55,500 as Strategy's Paper Loss Deepens
entry.summary: Strategy's disclosed bitcoin holdings were about $16.8 billion below their purchase cost as the cryptocurrency traded more than 26% below the company's average acquisition price.

entry.title: Bitcoin Falls 8% as Liquidations Reach $2.38 Billion
entry.summary: Long positions accounted for 92.6% of CoinGlass's rolling 24-hour liquidation total, with 343,889 traders liquidated.

entry.title: Ether Slides Near $1,550, Down About 35% in Four Weeks
entry.summary: Bitcoin lost about 31% over the same window, while declines in Solana, BNB and Hyperliquid underscored the broader selloff.

entry.title: Bitcoin Falls Below $57,000 to Two-Year Low on Coinbase
entry.summary: Coinbase's $56,747 low put bitcoin 33.1% below its Oct. 21 intraday high, taking it further below June's trough.

entry.title: Bitquery Traces at Least $1.58 Million in Fluidkey Hack
entry.summary: Fluidkey says a logging-tool flaw let an attacker trigger transfers when users opened the app, even though private keys stayed on their devices.

entry.title: PancakeSwap Volume Rebounds 34% to $991 Million
entry.summary: BNB Chain accounted for $828 million of daily trading, while PancakeSwap’s weekly growth trailed Uniswap, Curve and Raydium.

entry.title: Sky Buybacks and Rewards Exceed Revenue in Llama Data
entry.summary: DefiLlama measured about $440,000 in revenue after estimated savings costs on Nov. 20, below its $827,000 valuation of buybacks and staking rewards.

entry.title: Sky TVL Falls 45% in a Week as USDC Reserve Shrinks
entry.summary: Sky's tracked assets fell to $2.24 billion in the Nov. 20 daily snapshot. A large decline in its USDC conversion reserve corroborates the contraction.

entry.title: Clayton Links Tech Outages to Maintenance and Upgrades
entry.summary: The intelligence chief described separate outages linked to maintenance and technical changes. Mark Warner pointed to pressure to patch AI-found flaws.

entry.title: Aave V4 Plan Would Put Idle USDC Into Circle Gateway
entry.summary: New sweeps would have to keep Gateway exposure within 10 million USDC and 25% of supply, while preserving cash for withdrawals and loans.

entry.title: S&P 500 Sinks 3.7%, Extending Slide to Seven Sessions
entry.summary: The index lost 8.6% for the week, while bitcoin also declined sharply over the past week.

entry.title: Oracle Says OpenAI Infrastructure Deal Is Fully Funded
entry.summary: The company says vendor financing is in place after November stock and bond sales, with Nvidia rack handovers at Shackelford still on track.

entry.title: Cloudflare Adds Ruby2Shell Rules; Ruby Patch Still Needed
entry.summary: Free-plan rules run automatically; paid sites need deployed, unoverridden managed rules. Traffic bypassing Cloudflare remains outside the shield, so Ruby still needs patching.

entry.title: Thinking Machines Releases Inkling 2 Mini for Local AI
entry.summary: The roughly 20GB model supports Apple silicon devices with 32GB or more memory. Its Apache 2.0 listing comes with a separate acceptable-use policy.

entry.title: 44 Attorneys General Challenge CFTC Prediction Rules
entry.summary: The coalition says federal derivatives oversight cannot replace state gambling safeguards. One rule remains proposed; its companion is already in effect.

entry.title: SEC Proposes Direct Control of Consolidated Audit Trail
entry.summary: The agency intends to use congressional appropriations for CAT operations, while exchanges and broker-dealers would keep reporting substantially the same data.

entry.title: December Fed Hike Odds Ease in Futures-Based Monitor
entry.summary: Investing.com’s monitor put December hike odds at 93.6%, down from 99.6% in its previous-day snapshot, while still overwhelmingly favoring an increase.

entry.title: Nvidia Slides Nearly 10% as Nasdaq 100 Falls Sharply
entry.summary: Reuters reported that SEC investigators are examining potential accounting issues at Nvidia, adding detail to a probe first reported on Nov. 17.

entry.title: Bitcoin Falls Below $58,000 but Holds Above June Low
entry.summary: Friday's low was less than $200 above Coinbase's June trough. The high-to-low decline from Oct. 21 reached 31.8%.

entry.title: BENQI Plans New Queue to Shorten sAVAX Unstaking Waits
entry.summary: Pending unstaking requests will carry over without losing time already waited, while existing holders will not need to move or swap their tokens.

entry.title: Stock Market Cap: What It Measures and What Losses Mean
entry.summary: With the share count unchanged, a falling price reduces quoted equity value. It does not, by itself, drain company cash or establish an operating loss.

entry.title: Sky's USDC Exit Reserve Rises 29% to 1.13 Billion
entry.summary: The shared USDS and DAI conversion reserve gained 254 million USDC between midday snapshots, but remained well below its level at the start of Nov. 19.

entry.title: Wagyu Operator Pledges Refunds After XMR1 Sell-Off
entry.summary: Scam Sniffer estimated the token sales brought in about $13.3 million in USDC. PerpetualCow pledged to cover losses personally.

entry.title: Amazon Says AI Agents Found and Exploited a Zero-Day
entry.summary: CJ Moses said agents took over a university server after discovering an upload flaw. Amazon assessed the attacker's China link with moderate confidence.

entry.title: LayerZero Sets Nov. 23 ZRO Staking Ahead of Zero
entry.summary: Rewards would come from new ZRO issuance, with no early exit. Terms expect unstaking to open by March 31, 2027, but warn that timing may change.

entry.title: Deribit Halts Trading as It Probes Platform Problems
entry.summary: The exchange logged an incident at 11:17 a.m. ET. Its trading screen said customers could still cancel open orders.

entry.title: Aster Blames Coordinated Trades for Mark-Price Divergence
entry.summary: Aster says its insurance fund took over positions and some profitable positions were forcibly reduced. Its report announces a safeguards review but no compensation plan.

entry.title: Bitcoin Touches $60,000 as Slide From Oct. 21 Hits 29%
entry.summary: Coinbase recorded $60,001 at 10:26 a.m. ET, while Bitstamp touched $60,000 in the same minute.

entry.title: Zcash Falls Below $800 as Losses Outpace Bitcoin, Ether
entry.summary: ZEC traded about 53% below a late-September price, extending a selloff that took it below $1,100 earlier this month.

entry.title: Intel 18A vs. TSMC N2: How to Read the Chip Claims
entry.summary: Node names are not transistor measurements. Public disclosures show different approaches to making chips faster and more efficient—but use different comparison points.

entry.title: PI Hits Record Low After Pi Network’s First Summit
entry.summary: PI lost about 26% in a week, compared with bitcoin’s 11%, while Pi outlined developer incentives and plans for mainnet trading tools.

entry.title: Anthropic Nears IPO Price After 27% Fall From High
entry.summary: ANT traded at $83.81 before the open on Nov. 20, down 13.75% from its first-day close and barely above its $83 offering price.

entry.title: Bitcoin ETF Outflows Hit $582 Million, Most Since Oct. 30
entry.summary: BlackRock's IBIT led the Nov. 19 bitcoin ETF withdrawals. Farside's tracked US spot ether ETFs, including staking products, had $131 million in net outflows.

entry.title: SpaceX Lenders Sought to Keep AI Chips on Earth: FT
entry.summary: The proposed restriction would protect lenders’ ability to reclaim collateral if SpaceX defaults, according to the Financial Times.

entry.title: Celestia's TIA Sinks 39% in Four Weeks, Erasing Rally
entry.summary: TIA's four-week decline exceeded bitcoin's by nearly 15 percentage points, while tracked blob data and dollar-valued network fees also fell from mid-October.

entry.title: Bitcoin Holds Near $61,700, Down 26% This Quarter
entry.summary: Early Friday trading stayed above Thursday night's low, but bitcoin was below its Nov. 14 trough at 6:26 a.m. ET on Coinbase.

entry.title: Kalshi Says Proposed New York Order Could Shut Exchange
entry.summary: New York’s gambling-enforcement case has returned to state court. Kalshi argues the proposed restrictions would reach customers nationwide because it operates from New York.

entry.title: XMR1 Seller Buys 7,467 ETH Amid Token's Price Collapse
entry.summary: The recipient of 5.2 million XMR1 also sent about 4,836 ETH to a new Ethereum address. Scam Sniffer described the activity as suspected theft.

entry.title: Rupee Withdrawal Problems Hit Three Crypto Exchanges
entry.summary: Coinbase is routing new requests through support, CoinDCX reports slower transfers, and ZebPay has reported bank-related delays.

entry.title: Nigeria Sets Nov. 30 Tax Portal Form Deadline for Crypto Firms
entry.summary: Platforms operating in Nigeria or serving its residents must also finish system integration by Dec. 31. The NRS says the portal creates no new taxes.

entry.title: OpenAI Brings GPT-Live-1.1 to API With Cheaper Standby
entry.summary: The $0.02-per-minute standby option also works with GPT-Live-1, but developers must enable it for WebRTC sessions. Backend models and tools cost extra.

entry.title: Anthropic Ends Debut Up 17% as Ondo Launches ANTon
entry.summary: Ondo announced that ANTon was live for minting and redemption, while Binance scheduled a shift from pre-IPO futures pricing to a stock-linked contract.

entry.title: Coinbase’s Anthropic Share Certificate Trades on Base
entry.summary: ANTc offers share-backed exposure, not direct stock ownership. Wallet buyers must satisfy vesting conditions to register as certificate owners and exercise its rights.

entry.title: AI Agent Builders: Visual Versus Code-First Tools
entry.summary: Compare n8n, Dify and LangGraph by coding, connections, hosting, human approvals and model billing—not by a single 'no-code' label.

entry.title: Google Expands Gemini’s Mac Automation With App Control
entry.summary: The computer-use rollout brings background clicking and typing to US subscribers on Plus, Pro and Ultra plans, with users choosing which apps Gemini can access.

entry.title: Sky Council Plans Extra Buybacks After SKY Price Slump
entry.summary: The Council’s seven-day plan adds 750,000 USDS in daily buybacks and is designed to keep the daily USDS allocation for staking rewards roughly steady.

entry.title: Sky’s USDS Circulating Supply Falls 39% in One Day
entry.summary: DefiLlama’s daily readings show roughly 2 billion fewer USDS in circulation. One Ethereum swap burned 400 million USDS and paid the sender USDC.

entry.title: Moonshot Drops $150 Million Blackwell Deal, Report Says
entry.summary: The Information says the Indonesian computing rental was due to start as early as 2027. New US licensing controls target offshore access to advanced chips.

entry.title: California Subpoenas Nvidia Over Investor Disclosures
entry.summary: Bonta's office is investigating whether advanced chips or confidential information reached China and whether Nvidia misled investors and the public.

entry.title: Wiz Suspects Certificate Compromise in Microsoft AI Package Hack
entry.summary: Wiz says a client certificate and private key for Microsoft's release service appear compromised. An initial upload attempt was blocked, but a second succeeded.

entry.title: SpaceX AI-Chip Debt Sale Raises $32 Billion: Report
entry.summary: Bloomberg reported yields topping 8% on bonds tied to an Apollo-managed financing for Nvidia chips that SpaceX plans to lease.

entry.title: Nginx Patches Five Flaws That Can Let Attackers Run Code
entry.summary: Cloudflare says its HTTP proxy blocks three nginx2root attack paths, but that protection depends on keeping origin servers out of attackers' direct reach.

entry.title: Tencent Releases Hy4 Weights With Limits for Large Hosts
entry.summary: Commercial use and modification are allowed, while qualifying model-service operators need separate permission. vLLM's default deployment uses eight B300 GPUs.

entry.title: Kalshi Loses Maryland Sports-Betting Appeal in Split Ruling
entry.summary: A split Fourth Circuit panel upheld the denial of Kalshi’s preliminary injunction, as the CFTC pushes its designated exchanges to ease geographic restrictions.

entry.title: Ledger CTO Charles Guillemet To Leave at End of 2026
entry.summary: The Donjon lab's founder says the transition has been prepared for months and he is building a new security project.

entry.title: Tether Burns 4 Billion USDT From Ethereum Treasury
entry.summary: The tokens came from Tether’s own inventory. The burn alone does not establish a fresh $4 billion drop in circulating USDT across blockchains.

entry.title: Taiwan's TAIEX Down 17% for Week in Friday Morning Trade
entry.summary: TSMC and Foxconn suffered double-digit weekly losses in Friday morning trading as Taiwan's tighter short-selling curbs took effect.

entry.title: Optimism’s OP Drops 25% in a Week, Trailing Bitcoin
entry.summary: The governance token has lost about 39% over 28 days, more than reversing its October rally. Ether also fell less sharply over both windows.

entry.title: Bitcoin Sets New Selloff Low of $61,220 on Coinbase
entry.summary: Its roughly four-week loss reached 24.6% on CoinGecko, while 38 of 40 tokens in a selected watchlist fell over 24 hours.

entry.title: Coinbase Plans In-House US Prediction Markets: Bloomberg
entry.summary: Kalshi currently operates the markets Coinbase offers. Bloomberg says the planned in-house contracts would serve retail and institutional customers, targeting the first half of 2027.

entry.title: SoftBank Sinks 16.6% Intraday as Asian Markets Slide
entry.summary: The OpenAI backer pared its loss to about 15% in early Tokyo trading, while the Nikkei 225 and Kospi fell more than 4%.

entry.title: Solana Resumes Upgrades With Direct-Mapping Warning
entry.summary: Direct mapping remains pending on mainnet without a firm activation date. Associated memory rules can break unsafe account access and some older Anchor patterns.

entry.title: Backpack Targets 10,000 Stocks With Solana Routing Plan
entry.summary: Ferrante outlined a system to route wallet orders to stock-market liquidity. Board member Kyle Samani said the expansion would arrive in the next few weeks.

entry.title: Wallet Tied to Rune Christensen Owes Half of Sky's Fully Borrowed Lending Pool
entry.summary: Liquidations for the collateral type are switched off, and the 2.5-cent price cap that governs those loans was proposed by Christensen in a forum post last year

entry.title: Mast Says US Cleared 879,868 AI Chips for Chinese Firms
entry.summary: The May snapshot covers Nvidia H200 and AMD MI325X chips across 21 applications, all listed as approved but not shipped.

entry.title: Nvidia Erases Earnings Bounce, Down About $632B Since Nov. 11
entry.summary: Shares were about 5% below their pre-earnings close Thursday afternoon, extending a decline that outpaced both semiconductor stocks and the Nasdaq 100.

entry.title: Bitcoin Falls Below $62,000 to Its Lowest Since July on Coinbase
entry.summary: The new Coinbase low broke the Nov. 14 trough and extended bitcoin's decline from its Oct. 21 intraday high to 27.3%.

entry.title: Binance.US Says Perps Bid Clears CFTC Completeness Check
entry.summary: The exchange seeks trading and clearing registrations for a US derivatives offering. Neither has been approved, and Binance.US says it offers no derivatives yet.

entry.title: Google Opens Genie 4 World Model to Developers
entry.summary: The paid Gemini API release supports interactive worlds with native audio, but caps sessions at two minutes and limits concurrent sessions by billing tier.

entry.title: OFAC Sanctions Comancheros Leader, Lists Tron Address
entry.summary: Chainalysis says the listed address and a Hamas-related wallet used the same intermediary cluster.

entry.title: Anthropic Perp Tops $1.4 Billion in 24-Hour Volume
entry.summary: Trade.xyz's ANT contract had about $283 million in open interest, with its mark price within 0.2% of Anthropic's Nasdaq-listed share price in a matched-minute comparison.

entry.title: ECB Flags Over $4 Trillion in Big Tech Commitments
entry.summary: The company-wide tally includes leases, purchases and financial backstops; the ECB highlights AI infrastructure contracts as one source of risk.

entry.title: Lighter Lists Anthropic-Linked Token on Robinhood Chain
entry.summary: ANT is a Robinhood-issued debt token, not direct Anthropic equity. US persons and investors in several other markets are excluded.

entry.title: Ethereum Execution Teams Lean Toward Keeping Glamsterdam Gas Rules
entry.summary: Hoodi remains unscheduled. Waiting until January to decide, then opting to revise Glamsterdam’s gas rules, could push mainnet to April or May 2027, Ansgar Dietrichs estimated.

entry.title: Fluidkey Urges Users to Avoid Website and App After Incident
entry.summary: The privacy-focused wallet said it was investigating a security incident affecting users. Its notice did not say whether funds had been lost.

entry.title: US Crypto Perps: Coinbase and Kraken Access Explained
entry.summary: Both advertise US access through futures brokers. Their public disclosures distinguish domestic accounts from global services, with separate approval checks.

entry.title: Sky Raises stUSDS Yield to 24.74%; App Shows $0 Liquidity
entry.summary: A borrower repaid about 414,000 USDS, and a bot contract redeemed stUSDS in the next transaction. Both preceded the rate increase. A later app snapshot showed no withdrawal liquidity.

entry.title: Anthropic Falls Below $100 After 34% Nasdaq Debut Pop
entry.summary: Shares recovered to $100.92 by 12:30 p.m. ET, about 9.5% below the opening trade but still 21.6% above the $83 IPO price.

entry.title: AMD Falls as Much as 11% After Hunterbrook China Report
entry.summary: The stock traded 10.4% below Wednesday’s close at 10:55 a.m. ET. Hunterbrook Media disclosed that affiliate Hunterbrook Capital was short AMD and said its findings do not establish chip sales to blacklisted firms.

entry.title: Anthropic Shares Jump 35% in Their Nasdaq Trading Debut
entry.summary: ANT traded at $112.20 against its $83 IPO price. The implied value depends on which shares are counted.

entry.title: Uniswap Adds Tokenized Anthropic Trading on IPO Day
entry.summary: Ondo lists Uniswap among platforms supporting ANTon, which offers economic exposure rather than direct share ownership and excludes US investors.

entry.title: Nadine Chakar to Leave DTCC After Tokenization Launch
entry.summary: CEO Frank La Salla says the digital-assets business will be aligned more closely with DTCC’s core operating model and structure.

entry.title: Crossmint Launches Menta for AI Shopping Across Assistants
entry.summary: Users can approve reusable budgets for cards saved with Crossmint. Developers can fork the app, but checkout and payment services still run through the company.

entry.title: Bitwise Files SEC Registration for a Zcash ETF
entry.summary: The proposed trust would hold Zcash to give shareholders exposure to its price, less expenses. Its registration statement is not yet effective.

entry.title: Sky's USDC Exit Reserve Falls $1.69 Billion in Hours
entry.summary: The PSM held about 872 million USDC by midday ET. Spark's head of strategy described pulling back ecosystem allocations to rebuild liquidity.

entry.title: dYdX Switches USDC Deposits From Noble to Injective
entry.summary: Existing trading balances and positions stay unchanged as dYdX gradually replaces Noble backing ahead of Circle’s January cutoff.

entry.title: xStocks' Anthropic Token Starts Trading on Solana
entry.summary: ANTx provides share-backed price exposure, not shareholder rights. xStocks announced trading after reporting it could not fill all IPO Access requests.

entry.title: Jito's JTO Falls 46% in 28 Days, Lagging BTC and ETH
entry.summary: JTO lost about 21% over seven days, compared with roughly 12% for bitcoin and 11% for ether. Jito's dollar-denominated fees also softened.

entry.title: Wallet Supplies 1.49 Billion USDC to Aave, Cutting Rates
entry.summary: Three deposits into Aave’s Ethereum V3 market increased USDC supply to about 4.24 billion and lowered borrowing costs and lender returns.

entry.title: Binance Wallet Announces Anthropic IPO Token Refunds
entry.summary: Binance Wallet says the campaign's roughly 2,957-token allocation will be given away, with an added $1 million ANTB airdrop, after subscriptions hit a 500 million USDC cap.

entry.title: Ondo Launches 24/7 Anthropic Token on IPO Day
entry.summary: ANTon offers eligible non-US investors round-the-clock minting and redemption, but holders own share-backed notes rather than Anthropic shares.

entry.title: Backpack's Anthropic Token Debuts on Solana on IPO Day
entry.summary: A Meteora ANT-USDC pool held about $1.06 million in assets shortly after noon ET. The wallet-held token is not a Nasdaq share, and access excludes US persons.

entry.title: Lido DAO Votes on Framework for Its Lending Protocol
entry.summary: Vote #207 would approve committees and market-management tools. Individual lending markets would still need separate approval, mainly through motions LDO holders can block.
